findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_hotlist, hn_search, comment_for_post, itunes_search, university_search · Private data: datamuse_synonyms, wallet_history, zenodo_search, opentdb_trivia, uuid, jwt_decode · Public sink: comment_for_post, eastmoney_ashare · Destructive: trend_predict, json_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_hotlist, hn_search, comment_for_post, itunes_search, university_search · Private data: datamuse_synonyms, wallet_history, zenodo_search, opentdb_trivia, uuid, jwt_decode · Public sink: comment_for_post, eastmoney_ashare · Destructive: trend_predict, json_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
